runtime.pytest: 2 passed: family history attribution and clinical attribution unit cases

implementation: The application attribution path classifies subject from the utterance text, exposes subject_attribution_source=utterance_content_only, and explicitly records that diarization roles are not used for subject attribution. Family kinship terms are mapped to family subject.
limitations: Text rules do not resolve every ambiguous pronoun or family relationship.
Role errors still require clinician review; this guard prevents a diarization role from silently overriding family-content attribution.
